sources.snippet: A from-scratch reimplementation of the TabPFN v2 classifier (Hollmann et al., Accurate predictions on small data with a tabular foundation model, Nature 637, 2025). The model and inference follow the paper's Methods, and the training data come from the open TabICL prior. Code: Aiden-Jeon/minipfn ...
